_doc: Event rules for matches.py/collector.py. live_tiers: "top" = live/collector cover only S/A (and B with top teams); notable_events (media/streamer) and demote_events are excluded from live entirely (reversible: set "all" to restore). "all" = previous behaviour: notable_events always live, demote_events only if no team ranked <= min_rank. Daily announce/results use matches.py without --live and still see media + demoted-with-top teams. See README 'Event rules'.
